identity.title: Explore, recognise and compare three different 3D shapes
identity.subject: Maths
identity.unit_title: Recognise, compose, decompose and manipulate 2D and 3D shapes

keywords.description: When one thing is like something else.
A 3D shape with one vertex, one circular face and one curved surface.
A 3D shape with one curved surface.
A 3D shape with two circular faces and one curved surface.

key_learning_points.keyLearningPoint: Recognise objects that are similar shapes.
3D shapes have 3 dimensions and are not flat.
A sphere is shaped like a ball.
A cylinder has 2 flat circle faces.
A cone has 1 vertex and 1 flat circle face.

learning.pupil_lesson_outcome: I can recognise, name and compare three different 3D shapes.

misconceptions.response: Allow additional practice for children to name shapes throughout the day, particularly those that are familiar within their environment.
misconceptions.misconception: Children might mix up words that sound alike e.g. similar and cylinder.
